executive_assessment.text: Named South Tarawa/Banaba water vulnerabilities are historical and undated in a draft-marked communication; survey evidence is national rather than island-resolved.
Relocation-related land disputes are a conditional risk. Whole-of-islands targets and remote warning approaches describe planned capacity, not verified beneficiaries or effects.
